review_candidates.title: Director, International Partnerships
review_candidates.description: The Director, International Partnerships will lead MLB’s International Partnership sales efforts to enhance MLB’s promotion and visibility in international markets and increase revenue across the League. This person will have strategic and operational responsibility for MLB’s International commercial partnership deals working in collaboration with MLB’s Regional Offices as well as the International Client Services team on the creation, implementation, strategic management and profitability of partner promotional programs and initiatives. Responsibilities International Sales Strategy & Leadership Advise senior leadership on MLB’s international partnership sales strategy to optimize sponsorship promotion, visibility, and revenue growth across international markets. Lead and develop an international team of partnership sales professionals across Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Mexico/LatAm, UK/Europe, and Canada, including training and performance management. Provide strategic & tactical guidance to regional International Sales and Client Services teams by reviewing and analyzing new and existing international partnership deals. Recommend global partnership targets by advising domestic and international sales teams on partners suited for multinational, cross-territory discussions. Partnership Development & Optimization Develop, review and analyze high-value global sponsorship sales processes and partner programs, providing recommendations to improve deal efficiency, strategic management, and long-term profitability. Develop strategic partnership recommendations for multinational sponsors using a category- and territory-based approach. Research and evaluate prospective partners to understand business needs and recommend opportunities that drive revenue growth and brand-building relationships. Sales Pipeline, Enablement & Governance Develop, review and optimize the international sales pipeline, sales presentations, and proposals, providing recommendations to improve efficiency, clarity, and conversion. Establish and reinforce a standardized global international sales framework, including deal structures, terminology, Salesforce workflows, and evolving sales materials. Partner with Sales Leads and Sales Support to strengthen pitches, proposals, term sheets, and executive materials, providing end-to-end deal guidance from sales analysis through activation planning. Cross-Functional Alignment & Global Execution Serve as the central liaison between International Sales, Activation, and MLB HQ to ensure assets, rights, territories, and categories are clearly defined and conflict-free prior to deal execution. Lead cross-functional coordination across Legal, Finance, Sales Support, Activation, Events, and venues to enable compliant deal structuring and seamless execution, including international events (e.g., International Series, World Baseball Classic). Maintain structured, proactive communication on prospects and active deals, aligning domestic and international priorities and leading global workstreams across time zones from deal conception through delivery. Contracting & Deal Oversight Provide leadership and oversight for the development, negotiation, and execution of third-party contracts supporting MLB’s international sponsorship and partnership initiatives. Oversee the end-to-end international contract workflow in partnership with Legal and Sales leadership, ensuring agreements meet commercial, operational, and compliance requirements. Ensure adherence to internal and external sales implementation processes, including Salesforce workflows, standardized documentation, and accurate financial reporting. Partner, Event & Asset Management Lead management of third-party partners supporting MLB international events, including promoters, broadcast and multimedia partners, and other commercial stakeholders. Collaborate with Sales leadership to plan and manage partner hospitality programs for marquee international events, including ticketing and hospitality inventory oversight. Lead the development of new territory-specific sponsorship assets and manage existing asset inventory across international events, media platforms, and emerging digital or content channels. Partner cross-functionally to identify and launch new sponsorship opportunities that drive incremental revenue and marketing impact in international markets. Reporting, Market & Venue Strategy Develop executive-level reporting and materials that communicate business performance, pipeline health, and key partnership updates to senior leadership. Travel to international markets to conduct on-site venue evaluations for MLB international events. Assess venue capabilities and constraints and partner with leadership to develop venue-specific commercial strategies that monetize signage, activations, and sponsorship assets. Qualifications & Skills Ten (10) or more years’ experience in corporate partnership sales A Bachelor’s degree in marketing, international business, economics or related discipline is required. An MBA or similar advanced degree is a plus. A successful track record of developing and closing complex, multi-year partnership deals. Knowledge of the history and culture of baseball is a strong plus. Professional demeanor, exceptionally organized and detail oriented. Strong organizational, analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills. Proficiency is one or more non-English languages is a plus. Ability to maintain confidentiality while dealing with sensitive information. Ability to travel extensively on a global basis. Travel is estimated at 30-40%. Strong working knowledge of MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Access and PowerPoint). Salary Range: $125,000 - $155,000 (Base Salary) + Commission As a candidate for this position, your salary and related aspects of compensation will be contingent upon your work experience, education, skills, and any other factors MLB considers relevant to the hiring decision. In addition to your salary, MLB believes in providing a competitive compensation and benefits package for its employees. Top MLB Perks & Benefits Competitive Benefits Package Company Contributed 401K Plan Paid Time Off and Holidays Paid Parental Leave Access to Free Tickets to Baseball Games & MLB.TV Discounts at MLB Store | MLBShop.com Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) Onsite/Online Training & Development Programs Tuition Reimbursement Disability Benefits (short term and long term) Life and Accidental Death Insurance Pet Insurance Why MLB? Major League Baseball (MLB) is the most historic of the major professional sports leagues in the United States and Canada. Employees love working at MLB because of the culture of growth, teamwork, and professionalism. Employees who are most successful at MLB take initiative, know how to identify problems and provide solutions, and always put the Team first. For those ready to step up to the plate and join the major leagues, MLB takes the same approach as teams do with their players: empowering our “workforce athletes” to be at their best by engineering experiences that put employees in the best position to succeed. Major League Baseball is looking for candidates who are passionate about growing America’s pastime to best serve its fans for decades to come. California Residents: Please see our California Recruitment Privacy Policy for more details. Colorado Residents: Colorado based applicants may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please email us at accommodations@mlb.com. review_candidates.title: Digital Growth & Experience Manager
review_candidates.description: Primary Duties And Responsibilities General Electric Credit Union is a not-for-profit, member-owned full service financial institution headquartered in Cincinnati with branches in Ohio and Kentucky. At GECU, we pride ourselves on maintaining quality service, being an employee-friendly workplace, and developing our team members while teaching you the skills to lead you to career advancement opportunities. Overview The Digital Growth & Experience Manager is responsible for developing and executing data-driven digital strategies that drives growth, engagement, and measurable business outcomes. This role leads the optimization of the Credit Union’s website and digital channels, with a strong focus on performance, user experience, and conversion. The position oversees SEO, paid media, and marketing automation strategies, ensuring an integrated approach to reaching and engaging members across the digital ecosystem. In addition, this role partners cross-functionally to leverage analytics and emerging technologies to continuously enhance digital performance and support organizational goals. Essential Responsibilities Leads and evolves digital marketing strategy with a focus on website performance, optimization, and conversion, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and member experience priorities. Owns website strategy and performance, including: Continuous analysis, testing, and optimization of user experience (UX), conversion paths, site functionality, and ADA compliance, identification and prioritization of enhancements and new capabilities, ongoing monitoring of site performance and implementation of data-driven improvements. Drives advanced SEO strategy, including traditional SEO and emerging Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)/AI Optimization (AIO) approaches to improve visibility across search engines and AI-driven discovery platforms. Owns the development and delivery of executive-level performance reporting and digital marketing roadmaps, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights that inform strategic decision-making and organizational priorities. Oversees marketing automation and personalization strategy, including: Integration of website, CRM, and marketing automation platforms, development of personalized member journeys and segmentation strategies, optimization of lifecycle marketing and engagement across digital touchpoints. Develops and oversees a structured, cross-channel testing and experimentation framework (A/B and multivariate testing) across website, paid media, and landing pages to drive continuous optimization and measurable performance improvement. Develops and executes integrated paid media strategies, in collaboration with external partners, to drive acquisition and retention, including: Paid search, display, and paid social media campaigns, develop and monitor digital campaign budgets, testing and optimization of targeting, creative, and channel mix, continuous improvement of cost efficiency and conversion outcomes. Leads a team and coaches toward organizational and professional development goals. Proactively evaluates, pilots, and implements emerging marketing technologies, including AI driven tools and platforms, to enhance digital performance, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive advantage. Collaborates with Communications team leaders, cross-functionally, and with external partners to deliver seamless, connected digital experiences and ensure successful implementation of new technologies and enhancements. Monitors the competitive landscape, industry trends, and emerging digital practices, translating insights into actionable strategic recommendations that inform campaign, channel, and website optimization strategies. Develops and maintains documented standards, systems, and procedures. Ensures all materials comply with applicable federal and state regulations and internal policies. Performs other duties as assigned. Education And Experience Bachelor’s degree in marketing or related field with 3-5 years’ experience. Experience with website optimization, analytics, and user experience improvements, as well as developing and executing paid media strategies, including search and social. Familiarity with marketing automation/CRM systems and personalization strategies preferred. Prior experience leading a team or managing cross-functional initiatives preferred. Experience with: Web analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Data studio, etc.), SEO research and tools (e.g., SEMRush), content management systems (CMS, Kentico preferred), paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta, etc.), email marketing or marketing automation platforms, familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Asana) and Adobe Creative Cloud is a plus. Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Exceptional writing, communication, proofreading, grammar, and editing capabilities; attention to detail, with consistency in style, tone, and voice. Strong analytical and data storytelling skills, with the ability to translate performance data into actionable insights and recommendations. Strategic thinking and execution, connecting digital initiatives to business goals and driving measurable outcomes. Experience with website optimization, SEO, and paid media strategy, including testing, targeting, and performance improvement. Project management and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and clearly communicate across audiences. Leadership and collaboration skills, including team development, cross-functional partnership, and vendor management. Ability to adapt to evolving tools, technologies, and trends while balancing strategic direction with hands-on execution. At GECU, we want to support your wellbeing by offering a wide range of benefits: Health, Dental and Vision insurance Life and Disability insurance options Paid Time Off starts accruing once hired and take your birthday off -paid 401k Retirement plan with up to a 10% match of your base gross compensation Tuition reimbursement opportunities & professional development Volunteer opportunities -and earn additional PTO hours! On-site clinics for Vaccines and Mammograms And many more! Come join GECU as we are a curated culture of respect, understanding, and mutual recognition. We believe forming bonds and connecting with each other only stands to strengthen the service we provide to our members in our mission of improving the Quality of Financial lives! General Electric Credit Union is an Equal Opportunity Employer

review_candidates.description: Organization Médecins Sans Frontières Posted 24 Aug 2026 Closing date 30 Nov 2026 Médecins Sans Frontières, association médicale humanitaire internationale créée en 1971, apporte une assistance médicale à des populations dont la vie est menacée : principalement en cas de conflits armés, mais aussi d'épidémies, de pandémies, de catastrophes naturelles ou encore d'exclusion des soins. Nous recherchons activement des Coordinateurs.trices Ressources Humaines (CoRH) pour intégrer les équipes opérant dans les pays d’intervention de MSF France. Votre mission Membre de l’équipe de coordination, vous êtes responsable de définir, adapter, planifier et superviser la stratégie RH de la mission. Vous garantissez une gestion des ressources humaines cohérente avec les besoins opérationnels, le cadre légal local, les politiques de MSF et les défis du terrain. Vous êtes un·e véritable partenaire stratégique des équipes opérationnelles. Vos responsabilités principales En tant que Coordinateur·rice RH et membre de l’équipe de coordination, vous définissez et mettez en œuvre la stratégie RH de la mission, en garantissant sa cohérence avec les enjeux opérationnels, le contexte local, le cadre légal et les valeurs de MSF. Vous jouez un rôle de partenaire stratégique, en veillant à ce que la mission dispose des ressources humaines nécessaires, tant en quantité qu’en qualité, pour atteindre ses objectifs. Cela implique d’anticiper les besoins, d’ajuster la composition des équipes et de développer les compétences du personnel national et international. Vous êtes garant·e de la bonne gestion administrative, contractuelle et juridique du personnel, dans le respect des politiques MSF et des obligations locales. Vous assurez également la qualité du management RH, en accompagnant les responsables dans la définition des postes, veiller à l'établissement systématique des bilans individuels, identifier et suivre les besoins en formation, être force de proposition dans la réflexion sur la composition d'équipe. Vous êtes en charge du recrutement et de l’animation de votre équipe (support, visite terrain, bilans individuels…) en assurant un accompagnement régulier, notamment via des visites sur les projets. Profil recherché Expérience Minimum 2 ans en gestion des ressources humaines et en management d'équipe au moins 12 mois sur un poste de coordination dans le domaine humanitaire Compétences Et Aptitudes Bonne maîtrise d'Excel Capacité à organiser et prioriser la charge de travail Capacité d'analyse Esprit de synthèse et capacité à formaliser et à conceptualiser. Diplomatie, médiation Pédagogie Capacité à évoluer dans un milieu multiculturel et à démontrer son engagement et son soutien en faveur de la diversité, des comportements et des attitudes inclusifs et non discriminatoires. Langues Français atout important Anglais (C1) Langues supplémentaires appréciées : arabe, espagnol, portugais. Disponibilité : Engagement de 12 mois minimum Ce que nous offrons Contrat CDD de 12 mois, temps plein. Salaire (à partir du 1er novembre) entre 50K€ et 60K€ brut annuel en fonction de l'ancienneté et de l'expérience pertinente Prise en charge des fraacis liés à la mission (transport, visas, logement, vaccins, etc.). Assurances santé, rapatriement, retraite. Perspectives d’évolution : formations, accompagnement et développement de carrière dans un large éventail de contextes humanitaires. Pourquoi vous ? Vous êtes rigoureux·se, engagé·e, stratégique, à l’écoute, et vous souhaitez mettre vos compétences au service de populations en situation de vulnérabilité. Vous avez une vision globale de la gestion, et vous croyez qu'une mission réussie repose autant sur une bonne logistique que sur une gestion humaine et financière solide.
